summary.en: Start a standalone Lavik server with the official 0.1.0-beta.1 Docker image, connect with redis-cli, and keep your data across container replacements.
summary.zh-CN: 使用官方 0.1.0-beta.1 Docker 镜像启动单机 Lavik，通过 redis-cli 连接，并在替换容器时保留数据。

text.en: Install Docker Engine or Docker Desktop. The official eloqdata/lavik:0.1.0-beta.1 image supports Linux AMD64 and ARM64; Docker Desktop on Apple Silicon uses ARM64 natively. It packages the Minimal release with kernel TCP and io_uring. SPDK/DPDK are not included. Use Install With Binary for the Standard package and SPDK setup.
text.zh-CN: 安装 Docker Engine 或 Docker Desktop。官方 eloqdata/lavik:0.1.0-beta.1 镜像支持 Linux AMD64 和 ARM64；Apple Silicon 上的 Docker Desktop 使用原生 ARM64。镜像包含 Minimal 版本，使用内核 TCP 和 io_uring，不包含 SPDK/DPDK。如需 Standard 包和 SPDK 配置，请参阅二进制安装。

text.en: The Linux host or Docker VM must support io_uring. The example uses seccomp=unconfined to allow it and runs as UID/GID 10001:10001 without privileged mode. Reserve free disk space for the initial 1 GiB data file. Port 6379 must be free; use 127.0.0.1:16379:6379 instead if another Redis or Lavik instance is running.
text.zh-CN: Linux 主机或 Docker 虚拟机必须支持 io_uring。示例通过 seccomp=unconfined 放行，并以 UID/GID 10001:10001 运行，无需特权模式。请为初始 1 GiB 数据文件预留磁盘空间。6379 端口必须空闲；若已有 Redis 或 Lavik，可改为 127.0.0.1:16379:6379。

text.en: Install With Binary
text.zh-CN: 使用二进制安装

text.en: Run these commands in your terminal. No Dockerfile, source build, or host-installed Lavik binary is needed. The image includes redis-cli. Use a fresh named volume for your first installation.
text.zh-CN: 在终端执行以下命令，无需 Dockerfile、源码编译或在宿主机安装 Lavik。镜像已包含 redis-cli。首次安装请使用新的命名卷。

text.en: The listener is published only on localhost. On macOS, connect through this published port, not a Docker bridge address. These commands are for local use without authentication; configure authentication and TLS before exposing Lavik remotely.
text.zh-CN: 监听端口仅发布到本机回环地址。macOS 请使用发布的端口，不要连接 Docker 网桥地址。这些命令用于不启用认证的本地使用；远程开放前请配置认证和 TLS。

text.en: Allow a short startup wait. PING should return PONG, SET should return OK, and GET should return lavik. If startup is still in progress, check the logs and retry PING. A host-installed client can also connect with redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 (or your chosen host port).
text.zh-CN: 启动需要短暂等待。PING 应返回 PONG，SET 返回 OK，GET 返回 lavik。如果仍在启动，请检查日志并重试 PING。宿主机客户端也可使用 redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379（或您选择的宿主机端口）连接。

text.en: The entrypoint preallocates /data/lavik.data to 1 GiB on first start and uses two workers. Add -e LAVIK_DATA_SIZE=4G and -e LAVIK_THREADS=4 before the image name to change the defaults. Changing LAVIK_DATA_SIZE does not resize or truncate an existing data file. File logs and storage stay in the lavik-data volume. Never attach one data volume to two running servers.
text.zh-CN: 入口脚本在首次启动时预分配 1 GiB 的 /data/lavik.data，并使用两个工作线程。在镜像名之前添加 -e LAVIK_DATA_SIZE=4G 和 -e LAVIK_THREADS=4 可修改默认值。修改 LAVIK_DATA_SIZE 不会调整或截断已有数据文件。日志和数据保存在 lavik-data 卷中，切勿将同一数据卷挂载给两个同时运行的服务。

text.en: Additional server flags go after the image name; explicit long options override the matching defaults. Bind-mounted data directories must be writable by UID 10001. Supplying --data-file makes you responsible for preallocating that file. For a mounted Redis-style configuration, use lavik /etc/lavik/lavik.conf after the image name; that configuration owns the listener, storage, and all other settings.
text.zh-CN: 额外服务参数放在镜像名之后；显式长选项会覆盖对应默认值。绑定挂载的数据目录必须允许 UID 10001 写入。指定 --data-file 后，需要自行预分配该文件。如挂载 Redis 风格的配置文件，在镜像名后使用 lavik /etc/lavik/lavik.conf；此时监听地址、存储及其他设置全部由配置文件负责。

text.en: To replace the container, run docker stop -t 60 lavik, then docker rm lavik, and repeat the start command with the same lavik-data volume. Removing the container keeps the named volume. Deleting the volume deletes your database; do not remove it for a restart or upgrade.
text.zh-CN: 替换容器时，先执行 docker stop -t 60 lavik，再执行 docker rm lavik，然后使用相同的 lavik-data 卷重新运行启动命令。删除容器会保留命名卷；删除卷则会删除数据库，重启或升级时不要删除卷。

text.en: Run a Primary–Follower Cluster With Docker Compose
text.zh-CN: 使用 Docker Compose 运行主从集群

title.zh-CN: 使用 Docker Compose 安装

summary.en: Run the official beta.1 Compose example: three Meta voters, one Data primary, and one Data follower. Try native replication, controlled failover, and recovery with persistent volumes.
summary.zh-CN: 运行官方 beta.1 Compose 示例：三个 Meta 投票节点、一个 Data 主节点和一个 Data 从节点，体验原生复制、受控故障转移和持久卷恢复。

text.en: Install Docker with Compose v2. Reserve at least 4 GiB for the Docker VM and several GiB of free disk space. Both Linux AMD64 and ARM64 images are available. The cluster image eloqdata/lavik:0.1.0-beta.1-cluster contains Data, Meta, lavik-ctl, redis-cli, and the bootstrap helper, using the Minimal release with kernel TCP and io_uring. It does not include SPDK/DPDK or Lavik Admin.
text.zh-CN: 安装 Docker 和 Compose v2。为 Docker 虚拟机预留至少 4 GiB 内存及数 GiB 可用磁盘空间。镜像支持 Linux AMD64 和 ARM64。集群镜像 eloqdata/lavik:0.1.0-beta.1-cluster 包含 Data、Meta、lavik-ctl、redis-cli 和初始化工具，使用 Minimal 版本的内核 TCP 和 io_uring，不含 SPDK/DPDK 或 Lavik Admin。

text.en: This is a local evaluation cluster on one Docker host, not protection against host failure. It uses beta.1’s NuRaft Meta implementation. Start with fresh volumes; do not reuse volumes from the newer source-built Admin quick start. All 16,384 slots initially belong to one primary, with native replication to its follower. Meta manages their roles.
text.zh-CN: 这是在一台 Docker 主机上运行的本地评估集群，无法抵御主机故障。它使用 beta.1 的 NuRaft Meta 实现。请使用新卷，不要复用较新源码版 Admin 快速入门的卷。全部 16,384 个槽最初归属一个主节点，通过原生复制同步至从节点，角色由 Meta 管理。

text.en: The fixed bridge subnet 172.30.92.0/24 must be unused. Run only one copy of this example per Docker daemon. If necessary, change the addresses consistently in both compose.yaml and cluster.toml before the first startup. The containers run as UID/GID 10001:10001; seccomp=unconfined allows io_uring without privileged mode.
text.zh-CN: 固定网桥子网 172.30.92.0/24 必须未被占用。每个 Docker 守护进程仅运行一份此示例。需要调整时，请在首次启动前同时修改 compose.yaml 和 cluster.toml 中的地址，保持一致。容器以 UID/GID 10001:10001 运行，通过 seccomp=unconfined 允许 io_uring，无需特权模式。

text.en: Download the matching Compose file and manifest into a new directory. These links pin the dockerimages branch snapshot for beta.1; no repository clone or build is needed. Keep both files together, and run all subsequent Compose commands from this directory.
text.zh-CN: 将配套的 Compose 文件和清单下载到新目录。链接固定到 dockerimages 分支中适用于 beta.1 的快照，无需克隆仓库或编译。两个文件必须放在同一目录，后续 Compose 命令均在该目录中执行。

text.en: The initial primary publishes localhost:6379 and the initial follower localhost:6380. If occupied, run export LAVIK_PRIMARY_PORT=16779 LAVIK_FOLLOWER_PORT=16780 before the commands below and retain those settings for subsequent Compose commands. LAVIK_DATA_SIZE defaults to 1G per Data node and LAVIK_THREADS to 2.
text.zh-CN: 初始主节点发布 localhost:6379，从节点发布 localhost:6380。如果端口被占用，请先执行 export LAVIK_PRIMARY_PORT=16779 LAVIK_FOLLOWER_PORT=16780，并在后续 Compose 命令中保留这些设置。每个 Data 节点的 LAVIK_DATA_SIZE 默认为 1G，LAVIK_THREADS 默认为 2。

text.en: Wait for “Cluster is READY (one primary, one follower).” and a successful bootstrap exit. Ctrl-C stops following the logs without stopping the containers. Per-container health checks only show process availability; use cluster-status to check cluster_ready and the current owner. If bootstrap fails, inspect docker compose logs bootstrap and cluster status before taking action; never delete volumes to repair uncertain state.
text.zh-CN: 等待日志显示 “Cluster is READY (one primary, one follower).” 且 bootstrap 成功退出。Ctrl-C 只停止跟踪日志，不会停止容器。容器健康检查仅表示进程可用，请使用 cluster-status 检查 cluster_ready 和当前主节点。若初始化失败，先检查 docker compose logs bootstrap 及集群状态，不要通过删除卷来修复不确定的状态。

text.en: SET returns OK and GET returns lavik. The follower read sends READONLY and GET on the same connection; retry after replication catches up if the value has not arrived. The service names primary and follower describe initial roles, which can change.
text.zh-CN: SET 返回 OK，GET 返回 lavik。从节点读取会在同一连接上发送 READONLY 和 GET；若值尚未同步，请等待复制追上后重试。primary 和 follower 服务名仅描述初始角色，实际角色可能发生变化。

text.en: The cluster advertises Docker-internal addresses. Cluster-aware clients that follow MOVED redirects must run on the Compose network; the exec commands above do so. On macOS, host clients can connect directly through published ports but cannot follow redirects to bridge addresses. A remote deployment needs addresses reachable by every node and client, plus authentication and TLS. This example publishes Data ports only on loopback, does not publish Meta ports, and uses plaintext inside the Docker network.
text.zh-CN: 集群通告 Docker 内部地址。需要跟随 MOVED 重定向的集群客户端必须在 Compose 网络内运行，上述 exec 命令满足此条件。macOS 上的宿主机客户端可直连发布端口，但无法跟随指向网桥地址的重定向。远程部署需要所有节点和客户端都能访问的地址，以及认证和 TLS。本示例仅向回环地址发布 Data 端口，不发布 Meta 端口，Docker 网络内使用明文通信。

text.en: After the cluster is ready and replication has caught up, use the shipped lavik-ctl to transfer ownership of group-1. Inspect cluster-status afterward. redis-cli -c can follow the redirect from the old primary because it runs inside the Compose network.
text.zh-CN: 集群就绪且复制追上后，使用镜像内的 lavik-ctl 转移 group-1 的主节点所有权，随后检查 cluster-status。redis-cli -c 在 Compose 网络内部运行，因此可以跟随旧主节点返回的重定向。

text.en: Each of the two Data nodes and three Meta nodes has its own named volume. docker compose down preserves these five volumes. On startup, Meta loads its durable topology; bootstrap initializes only an uninitialized cluster and otherwise waits for recovery. It does not reapply the original role assignments. Automatic failover during recovery can change the owner, so discover it with cluster-status rather than relying on service names.
text.zh-CN: 两个 Data 节点和三个 Meta 节点各自拥有命名卷，docker compose down 会保留这五个卷。再次启动时，Meta 加载持久化拓扑；bootstrap 仅初始化尚未初始化的集群，否则等待恢复，不会重新强制应用最初的角色分配。恢复期间自动故障转移可能改变主节点，请通过 cluster-status 查询，不要依赖服务名。

text.en: Only for an intentional complete reset: docker compose down --volumes permanently deletes all five database volumes. Never add --volumes for a routine restart or upgrade. Changing LAVIK_DATA_SIZE does not resize existing files.
text.zh-CN: 仅在明确要完全重置时使用 docker compose down --volumes，它会永久删除全部五个数据库卷。日常重启或升级切勿添加 --volumes。修改 LAVIK_DATA_SIZE 不会调整已有数据文件的大小。

text.en: Manage a Primary–Follower Cluster and Set Up Grafana
text.zh-CN: 管理主从集群并配置 Grafana

summary.en: Move a standalone Redis dataset to a standalone Lavik instance using replication and a controlled write pause.
summary.zh-CN: 通过复制及受控暂停写入，将独立 Redis 数据集迁移到独立 Lavik 实例。

text.en: Use a fresh standalone Lavik target with enough disk and memory for the source dataset. Attaching a source can replace destination data. Do not use a Meta-managed / --cluster-enabled target: beta.1 rejects Redis replication in that mode. Take a source backup and rehearse the complete move before the production cutover.
text.zh-CN: 使用全新的独立 Lavik 目标实例，并确保磁盘和内存容量充足。连接源端可能替换目标数据。不要使用 Meta 管理或 --cluster-enabled 目标：beta.1 在此模式下拒绝 Redis 复制。备份源数据，并在生产切换之前演练完整迁移。

text.en: Beta.1 imports RDB versions 1–11 and logical databases 0–15. A newer Redis release or an unsupported encoding can prevent full synchronization. Self-describing Module 2 and Function-library records may be skipped with a warning; older or unknown formats can be rejected. Inventory these separately and recreate only features supported by Lavik. Unsupported incremental commands stop replication. Check your command set, scripts, TTLs, ACL requirements and client settings. Use a length-delimited full-sync stream: configure repl-diskless-sync no on each Redis source through your normal configuration process. Coordinate that source-side change with its owner and account for RDB disk space and fork overhead.
text.zh-CN: beta.1 导入 RDB 版本 1–11，逻辑数据库范围为 0–15。较新的 Redis 版本或不支持的编码可能阻止全量同步。自描述的 Module 2 及 Function 库记录可能在警告后被跳过；较早或未知格式可能被拒绝。请单独盘点，并仅重建 Lavik 支持的功能。不支持的增量命令会停止复制。核对命令、脚本、TTL、ACL 需求及客户端设置。使用带长度的全量同步流：通过正常配置流程，在每个 Redis 源端配置 repl-diskless-sync no。与源端负责人协调此变更，并预留 RDB 磁盘空间和 fork 开销。

text.en: Check Command And Client Compatibility
text.zh-CN: 检查命令及客户端兼容性

text.en: The command examples assume private, trusted endpoints with no authentication for a rehearsal. Set LAVIK_HOST, LAVIK_PORT, REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT to the actual endpoints. Lavik must be able to reach Redis directly; localhost refers to Lavik’s own host or container. Configure upstream credentials and TLS before attaching authenticated sources; never put passwords in copied terminal commands or expose an unauthenticated instance publicly.
text.zh-CN: 命令示例用于可信私有网络、无认证的演练环境。将 LAVIK_HOST、LAVIK_PORT、REDIS_HOST、REDIS_PORT 设置为实际地址。Lavik 必须能直接访问 Redis；localhost 指 Lavik 自己的主机或容器。连接已启用认证的源端之前，先配置上游凭据和 TLS；不要把密码放在复制的终端命令中，也不要公开暴露无认证实例。

text.en: Watch INFO replication and the Lavik logs until master_link_status is up and master_sync_in_progress is 0. Perform real reads as well. A process restart requests a new FULLRESYNC; Redis offsets are not crash-persisted in beta.1. Do not route production traffic to a target still synchronizing.
text.zh-CN: 查看 INFO replication 及 Lavik 日志，直到 master_link_status 为 up 且 master_sync_in_progress 为 0，并进行实际读取。进程重启会请求新的 FULLRESYNC；beta.1 不会持久化 Redis 复制偏移量。不要把生产流量路由到仍在同步的目标。

text.en: An OK response acknowledges the role change; it does not mean the copy is complete. Keep the target attached until initial sync finishes and normal reads work. Pause every source writer, including scheduled jobs. Capture each source’s replication offset after the write pause, identify the Lavik replica connection, and confirm its ACK reaches that captured watermark. Replication PINGs and expiration traffic can continue advancing offsets. Compare representative values, data types, key counts and TTLs. Cluster sources require this check independently for every primary. Do not detach during LOADING: an incomplete load can be discarded. If a stream fails or any data type is missing, keep the source authoritative and fix the problem before cutover.
text.zh-CN: OK 只确认角色变更，不表示复制完成。保持连接，直到初始同步完成且正常读取可用。暂停所有源端写入，包括定时任务。暂停写入后，记录每个源端的复制偏移量，识别 Lavik 副本连接，并确认其 ACK 达到所记录的位点。复制 PING 和过期流量可能继续推进偏移量。核对代表性值、数据类型、键数量和 TTL。集群的每个主节点都需独立检查。不要在 LOADING 期间脱离：不完整的加载可能被丢弃。流失败或缺少任何数据类型时，继续以源端为准，解决问题后再切换。

text.en: After ROLE reports master, point applications at the Lavik endpoint and resume writes there. Run a small application read/write check before restoring full traffic. Keep Redis fenced against writes. Rollback is a routing change only before Lavik accepts new writes; afterwards reconcile or replay those writes before returning to Redis. REPLICAOF is not a bidirectional migration or a zero-data-loss guarantee.
text.zh-CN: ROLE 返回 master 后，将应用切换到 Lavik 地址，并在 Lavik 恢复写入。全面恢复流量之前，先运行少量应用读写检查。保持 Redis 禁写。只有在 Lavik 尚未接收新写入之前，回滚才只是路由切换；之后若要返回 Redis，必须先对账或重放新增写入。REPLICAOF 不是双向迁移，也不保证零数据丢失。

summary.en: Consolidate a stable Redis Cluster dataset into standalone Lavik, with one replication stream per source primary.
summary.zh-CN: 为每个源端主节点建立复制流，将稳定的 Redis Cluster 数据集汇入独立 Lavik。

text.en: Use a fresh standalone Lavik target with enough disk and memory for the source dataset. Attaching a source can replace destination data. Do not use a Meta-managed / --cluster-enabled target: beta.1 rejects Redis replication in that mode. Take a source backup and rehearse the complete move before the production cutover.
text.zh-CN: 使用全新的独立 Lavik 目标实例，并确保磁盘和内存容量充足。连接源端可能替换目标数据。不要使用 Meta 管理或 --cluster-enabled 目标：beta.1 在此模式下拒绝 Redis 复制。备份源数据，并在生产切换之前演练完整迁移。

text.en: This workflow consolidates source shards into one standalone Lavik instance; it does not preserve Redis Cluster node IDs or turn the destination into a Meta-managed Lavik cluster. Configure a standalone client for the new endpoint at cutover. If you need a Meta-managed destination instead, plan a separate application-level transfer into a freshly created Lavik topology.
text.zh-CN: 此流程将源分片汇入一个独立 Lavik 实例，不保留 Redis Cluster 节点 ID，也不会将目标变成 Meta 管理的 Lavik 集群。切换时为新地址配置独立模式客户端。如需 Meta 管理的目标，应规划独立的应用级数据转移，将数据写入新建的 Lavik 拓扑。

text.en: Beta.1 imports RDB versions 1–11 and logical databases 0–15. A newer Redis release or an unsupported encoding can prevent full synchronization. Self-describing Module 2 and Function-library records may be skipped with a warning; older or unknown formats can be rejected. Inventory these separately and recreate only features supported by Lavik. Unsupported incremental commands stop replication. Check your command set, scripts, TTLs, ACL requirements and client settings. Use a length-delimited full-sync stream: configure repl-diskless-sync no on each Redis source through your normal configuration process. Coordinate that source-side change with its owner and account for RDB disk space and fork overhead.
text.zh-CN: beta.1 导入 RDB 版本 1–11，逻辑数据库范围为 0–15。较新的 Redis 版本或不支持的编码可能阻止全量同步。自描述的 Module 2 及 Function 库记录可能在警告后被跳过；较早或未知格式可能被拒绝。请单独盘点，并仅重建 Lavik 支持的功能。不支持的增量命令会停止复制。核对命令、脚本、TTL、ACL 需求及客户端设置。使用带长度的全量同步流：通过正常配置流程，在每个 Redis 源端配置 repl-diskless-sync no。与源端负责人协调此变更，并预留 RDB 磁盘空间和 fork 开销。

text.en: Inventory every slot-owning primary from CLUSTER NODES and require complete, non-overlapping coverage of slots 0–16383. Resolve failures and migrating/importing slots before starting. Suspend resharding and automatic scale operations for the migration window. A stable primary failover retaining exactly the same slots can be discovered; a changed slot layout is not merged automatically and can stop all source sessions. Restore a stable layout and reattach all required primaries before continuing.
text.zh-CN: 从 CLUSTER NODES 盘点每个持有槽的主节点，要求完整且不重叠地覆盖 0–16383 槽。开始之前解决故障及 migrating/importing 状态。在迁移窗口暂停重分片和自动扩缩容。保持完全相同槽集合的主节点故障切换可被发现；槽布局变化不会自动合并，可能停止所有源会话。恢复稳定布局，并重新连接全部所需主节点后再继续。

text.en: The command examples assume private, trusted endpoints with no authentication for a rehearsal. Set LAVIK_HOST, LAVIK_PORT, REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT to the actual endpoints. Lavik must be able to reach Redis directly; localhost refers to Lavik’s own host or container. Configure upstream credentials and TLS before attaching authenticated sources; never put passwords in copied terminal commands or expose an unauthenticated instance publicly.
text.zh-CN: 命令示例用于可信私有网络、无认证的演练环境。将 LAVIK_HOST、LAVIK_PORT、REDIS_HOST、REDIS_PORT 设置为实际地址。Lavik 必须能直接访问 Redis；localhost 指 Lavik 自己的主机或容器。连接已启用认证的源端之前，先配置上游凭据和 TLS；不要把密码放在复制的终端命令中，也不要公开暴露无认证实例。

text.en: The example below shows three source primaries. Define REDIS_HOST_2 / REDIS_PORT_2 and REDIS_HOST_3 / REDIS_PORT_3 as well, and repeat ADDREPLICAOF for additional primaries. All primaries must advertise reachable addresses and the same frozen slot layout. The target remains LOADING until all advertised slot-owning primaries are registered and synchronized. Do not attach replicas or overlapping sources.
text.zh-CN: 以下示例有三个源端主节点。另行定义 REDIS_HOST_2 / REDIS_PORT_2 及 REDIS_HOST_3 / REDIS_PORT_3；更多主节点需继续执行 ADDREPLICAOF。所有主节点须公布可达地址及相同的固定槽布局。全部持槽主节点注册并同步完成之前，目标保持 LOADING。不要连接副本或槽集合重叠的源端。

text.en: Inspect the per-source entries in INFO replication and verify keys from every source primary. The overall link state or one successful GET is insufficient. If Lavik restarts, replay the complete source attachment sequence; runtime additions and Redis replication cursors are not persisted.
text.zh-CN: 检查 INFO replication 的每个源端条目，并验证来自每个源主节点的键。仅检查总体连接状态或成功读取一个键是不够的。Lavik 重启后，应重放完整的源端连接顺序；运行时新增源端及 Redis 复制游标不会持久化。

text.en: An OK response acknowledges the role change; it does not mean the copy is complete. Keep the target attached until initial sync finishes and normal reads work. Pause every source writer, including scheduled jobs. Capture each source’s replication offset after the write pause, identify the Lavik replica connection, and confirm its ACK reaches that captured watermark. Replication PINGs and expiration traffic can continue advancing offsets. Compare representative values, data types, key counts and TTLs. Cluster sources require this check independently for every primary. Do not detach during LOADING: an incomplete load can be discarded. If a stream fails or any data type is missing, keep the source authoritative and fix the problem before cutover.
text.zh-CN: OK 只确认角色变更，不表示复制完成。保持连接，直到初始同步完成且正常读取可用。暂停所有源端写入，包括定时任务。暂停写入后，记录每个源端的复制偏移量，识别 Lavik 副本连接，并确认其 ACK 达到所记录的位点。复制 PING 和过期流量可能继续推进偏移量。核对代表性值、数据类型、键数量和 TTL。集群的每个主节点都需独立检查。不要在 LOADING 期间脱离：不完整的加载可能被丢弃。流失败或缺少任何数据类型时，继续以源端为准，解决问题后再切换。

text.en: After ROLE reports master, point applications at the Lavik endpoint and resume writes there. Run a small application read/write check before restoring full traffic. Keep Redis fenced against writes. Rollback is a routing change only before Lavik accepts new writes; afterwards reconcile or replay those writes before returning to Redis. REPLICAOF is not a bidirectional migration or a zero-data-loss guarantee.
text.zh-CN: ROLE 返回 master 后，将应用切换到 Lavik 地址，并在 Lavik 恢复写入。全面恢复流量之前，先运行少量应用读写检查。保持 Redis 禁写。只有在 Lavik 尚未接收新写入之前，回滚才只是路由切换；之后若要返回 Redis，必须先对账或重放新增写入。REPLICAOF 不是双向迁移，也不保证零数据丢失。
